title: Lost Mary BM600 Cola Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Cola delivers the unmistakable taste of classic cola soda — sweet, familiar, and lightly tangy with a refreshing, bubbly character. It’s a straight-up soft drink flavour that brings nostalgic appeal in a simple, satisfying vape. Ideal for those who enjoy clean, fuss-free profiles inspired by their favourite beverages. Each pack contains two 2ml prefilled pods designed for use with the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit. The 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid provides a smooth MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape with fast-acting nicotine satisfaction. Each pod delivers up to 600 puffs depending on usage. When finished, just click in a fresh pod to keep the experience going.
